title: ReefHub, Aimbot, Auto Dunk, Auto Spin, Auto Steal & More!
features:
Key Features

Gameplay Enhancement

New Feature Added: Perfect Release!

The menu now includes "Perfect Release"—automatically shoots perfectly into the hoop from any range, including full court!

Auto Face Hoop - Automatically face the target hoop when taking shots

Auto Block Shots - Intelligent shot-blocking with automatic player detection

Ball Control - Direct mouse-based ball control for precision plays

Bigger Hitbox - Increased ball interaction radius for easier contact

No Jump Cooldown - Unlimited jumping for advanced mobility

Movement & Speed

TPWalk - Teleport-based movement for instant speed boosts

Adjustable Speed Multiplier - Fine-tune movement velocity

Auto Reach Distance Control - Customizable defensive positioning range

Customization

Clothing Presets - Quick-swap outfit system with multiple preset combinations

RGB Color Customization - Full color control for clothing (0-255 per channel)

Rainbow Mode - Dynamic color cycling for unique visual style

Custom Style & Zone Selection - Advanced player customization system

Map System

8 Unique Maps - Downtown Court, Original Map, Park Court, Beach Court, Neighborhood Court, Neon Arena, InDoor Court, Lukas Court

Dynamic Map Loading - Seamless map switching with automatic asset cleanup

Time of Day Settings - Per-map lighting and environment presets

Player Intelligence

Show Player Info ESP - Real-time player Style and Zone information displayed above player heads

Live Data Tracking - Continuous monitoring of other players' stats

Magnet System

Adjustable Magnet Radius - Customize detection range for hoop magnetism

Status Toggle - Easy enable/disable for core features

Additional Features

Cross-platform support (PC/Mobile optimized)

Responsive UI with drag functionality

Expiration-based licensing with Discord support

Comprehensive settings panel
